body.x: Netatmo(https://www.netatmo.com), an innovation company developing consumer electronics for a better and connected lifestyle, unveils Welcome at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Welcome, the frst smart home camera featuring revolutionary face recognition technology that recognizes each family member, sends the names of the people it sees to the user’s smartphone. The camera also notifes users when it detects an unknown face. Welcome won four awards at the renowned 2015 CES Innovations Awards in the following categories: Smart Home, Home Appliances, Digital Imaging and Tech for a better World. For the third consecutive year, Netatmo has been compensated for its successes. Welcome’s face recognition technology enables identification of people, refers people by their names and notifes the user when a stranger’s face appears.
